scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] structures one Maui week around snorkeling, hikes, resort evenings, and historic stops, assigning a dry bag, daypack, and small evening carrier separate jobs so wet excursions do not expose every item.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]把毛伊岛一周安排在浮潜、徒步、度假村晚间活动和历史景点之间，并让防水袋、日用背包和小型晚间用包各自承担不同任务，避免涉水活动让所有物品都暴露在潮湿中。
examples: using Waterproof for the carrier protecting a phone and dry essentials during snorkeling
using Water Resistant for a land daypack under brief showers
using Not Waterproof for a dry resort-evening carrier whose contents never face exposure

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a budget summer camping route through northern Norway, [X] moves by ferry and kayak between exposed camps and keeps electronics in a dedicated dry bag while the main pack still serves ordinary trail and transit days.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在挪威北部的低预算夏季露营路线中，[X]会乘渡轮和皮划艇往返于暴露营地之间，把电子设备放进专用防水袋，同时让主背包继续承担普通徒步和交通日的装载。
examples: using Waterproof for electronics during kayaking, ferries, and sudden mountain storms
using Water Resistant for a main pack under brief trail exposure
using Not Waterproof only when every vulnerable item already sits in the separate dry bag

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo, budget-conscious winter walk of the full Camino Frances, [X] evaluates a thirty-to-forty-liter backpack, its rain cover, and internal dry bags together across rain, snow, daily hostel stops, and weeks of repeated use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备以有限预算独自走完冬季法国之路时，[X]会在雨雪、每日青旅停留和数周反复使用中，把 30 至 40 升背包连同防雨罩和内部防水袋作为一整套系统评估。
examples: using Waterproof when the main pack itself must protect the full load through sustained winter exposure
using Water Resistant when the cover and inner dry bags handle prolonged rain
using Not Waterproof only when a familiar pack remains reliable inside the complete liner system

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a fixed family day at Beacon Bay Beach, [X] separates cold food, a phone, towels, and wet clothes among a cooler bag, protected phone carrier, and ordinary clothing container so each bag handles only the exposure its contents require.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在已经确定的灯塔湾家庭海滩日中，[X]会把冷食、手机、毛巾和湿衣物分别放入保冷包、手机防护袋和普通衣物袋，使每只包只承担其内容物真正需要的防水程度。
examples: using Waterproof for the phone carrier near swimming and splashes
using Water Resistant for incidental splash around mostly dry beach contents
using Not Waterproof when wet clothes already have separate containment and no valuables depend on the outer bag

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] evaluates one named Swissgear laptop backpack in light rain, checking whether its water-resistant body and robust construction are sufficient for a fixed computer-and-notebook load without confusing resistance with full sealing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]会在小雨条件下评估一款有明确型号的 Swissgear 笔记本电脑背包，检查其防泼水包身和坚固结构能否保护固定的电脑与笔记本负载，同时避免把防泼水误写成完全防水。
examples: using Water Resistant for the source-stated light-rain protection
requiring stronger evidence before upgrading the same bag to Waterproof
rejecting Not Waterproof when the daily computer has no separate protected liner

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a single backpack, [X] repeatedly walks bridges, boards water buses, and plans around possible high water, balancing protection for a small trip load against price and ease on repeated stairs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 只带一只背包时，[X]会反复步行过桥、乘坐水上巴士并应对可能出现的高水位，因此要在保护小型旅行负载、控制价格和上下楼梯便利之间权衡。
examples: using Waterproof when high-water alerts and exposed transfers threaten the week's only bag
using Water Resistant for ordinary rain and brief vaporetto exposure
using Not Waterproof only for a dry forecast and an indoor-heavy plan with separate document protection

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Driving alone, [X] links Mpumalanga waterfall trails, swimming holes, viewpoints, and a guesthouse over four summer days; a twenty-to-twenty-five-liter daypack faces afternoon storms and wet trails but returns to the car or room each evening.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自驾车时，[X]用四个夏日串联姆普马兰加的瀑布小径、游泳水潭、观景点和旅馆；20 至 25 升日用包会遇到午后雷雨和湿滑道路，但每天晚上都能回到汽车或房间。
examples: using Waterproof when phone, power bank, first aid, and a dry layer remain exposed through storms and spray
using Water Resistant when the car provides quick shelter from short storms
using Not Waterproof on a stable day when electronics remain in the car

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a four-day family bus loop through Kanazawa, Shirakawa-go, and Takayama, [X] travels with two children who carry small backpacks through April rain, melting snow, puddles, a crowded night festival, and long transfers with spare socks and jackets inside.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在金泽、白川乡和高山之间的四日家庭巴士环线中，[X]带着两个孩子出行；孩子们背着小背包经历四月降雨、融雪、水洼、拥挤夜祭和长途换乘，包内还装有备用袜子与外套。
examples: using Waterproof when each child's pack must independently keep spare layers dry
using Water Resistant when the backpack sits under a poncho but still meets puddles and short showers
using Not Waterproof on a dry transfer when parents hold all moisture-sensitive layers

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] and family take a one-year-old from Cardiff to the Cotswolds, alternating shallow river play, pushchair walks, pubs, and rainy indoor backups while keeping toys, board books, stacking cups, and other baby essentials in one frequently opened bag.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]和家人带一岁幼儿从加的夫前往科茨沃尔德，在浅水河边活动、推车步行、酒吧用餐和雨天室内备选之间切换，并把玩具、纸板书、叠叠杯等婴儿必需品放在一只频繁开合的包里。
examples: using Water Resistant beside the river, pushchair, and intermittent rain
using Waterproof for prolonged exposed weather away from the cottage
using Not Waterproof when the bag moves only among car, cottage, pub, and indoor activities

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At age twenty, [X] commits to a one-week solo Bolivia backpacking route with La Paz markets, overnight buses, a forty-liter backpack, and the Uyuni salt flats, where choosing the cheaper rainy-season mirror effect changes the daypack's exposure.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 20 岁的[X]确定了一周玻利维亚独自背包路线，包括拉巴斯市场、夜间巴士、40 升主背包和乌尤尼盐沼；是否选择更便宜的雨季镜面景观，会直接改变日用包面临的涉水程度。
examples: using Waterproof for the rainy mirror-effect season with phone, documents, and layers on the flats
using Water Resistant for a drier shoulder-season departure with short showers
using Not Waterproof only for a forecast-dry week with vulnerable contents separately protected
